name: en meeting, Korean notes
transcript: Thanks everyone for joining. Let's start with the security review.
The audit found two medium issues, both in the upload service.
We agreed last week to fix them before the release. Priya, you own the upload service, right?
Yes. I'll patch both issues and share the pull request by Tuesday.
Great. Next, the pricing page. Marketing wants to launch the new plans on the first of December.
That works for us, so let's go with December first.
Legal still needs to approve the new terms, and we don't have an answer yet.
Carlos, can you follow up with legal and tell us by Monday?
I will email them today and report back on Monday.
One more thing: should we support Japanese at launch? Nobody has decided that.
